Frequently asked questions

Can't find what you are looking for? Our support team answers most messages within one business day.

Is my data encrypted?

Yes. Notes are encrypted in transit and at rest. Only you can read the content of private notebooks.

Can I use Notely offline?
Notes you opened recently stay available offline, and changes sync when you reconnect.
How do I cancel my subscription?

Open the billing page and choose to cancel. You keep access until the end of the current period.

  • Refunds are available within fourteen days of purchase.
